meta.source: docs/PLAN.md sections 5 and 5a, docs/design/plum-and-peach.html (Sharpened), docs/design/storyboard.html (Midnight Gold). Plum and Peach is primary (decided October 30, 2026).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Ground of every screen, sheet, notification and card. Blush by day, deep plum at night.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Fields, the capture sheet and cards set on surface. Plum night's card color comes from PLAN 5a; the others were added in phase 1.

tokens.name: deep
tokens.usage: Lock Screen wallpaper and outside-the-app grounds (widget frame, Watch). Dark in every mode.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Your words: reasons, titles, body. 12.7:1 or better on surface and surface-raised in every mode.

tokens.name: quiet
tokens.usage: Dates, times, sources, labels, hints. Never a reason. Plum day darkened from #806a7c (4.33:1) to #776174 (4.93:1) in phase 1.

tokens.name: act
tokens.usage: Fill of the one action on a screen (Read now, Save, Book it). Plum by day, peach at night (gold in Midnight Gold). One per screen; never decoration, an icon or a divider.

tokens.name: on-act
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on act. 8.6:1 or better.

tokens.name: act-edge
tokens.usage: 1px edge on the act fill. Needed in Midnight Gold Day, where gold alone is 1.8:1 on surface.

tokens.name: act-text
tokens.usage: The one action set as text where a fill won't fit (Watch, Bring it back). Counts as the screen's act. Midnight Gold Day darkened from #8a6a1c to #86671b in phase 1.

tokens.name: mark
tokens.usage: The app mark on a moment's top line. Peach in both Plum modes, from the reference page; in Plum night it shares the act's color, the one allowed exception, because it isn't tappable.

tokens.name: done
tokens.usage: Done state: the check and the Done word. Plum's faded cyan, darkened by day (#7fa8a6 was 2.29:1) to #3f6e6c (5.05:1). Midnight Gold Day darkened from #5f8a74 to #4a725e.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and sections. Decorative only: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: control-line
tokens.usage: Outline of secondary buttons, fields and the microphone. 3.2:1 or better on surface in every mode.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: The thin inner edge of cards (shadow-edge). Decorative.

tokens.name: fill-soft
tokens.usage: Search field ground; pressed state of secondary buttons.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid, 2px offset. 4.7:1 or better on every surface.

styles.name: reason-xl
styles.sample: Read before we plan next quarter.
styles.usage: A save opened in the app; the Issue's lead line when expanded.

styles.name: reason-lg
styles.usage: Expanded notification, Live Activity, the Issue cover.

styles.name: reason-md
styles.sample: Try the long cold ferment this weekend.
styles.usage: Lock Screen notification, the reason field, Coming back rows.

styles.name: reason-sm
styles.sample: Book the campsite at Carolina Beach.
styles.usage: Watch, compact Live Activity, widgets, the Issue's other lines.

styles.name: day-numeral
styles.usage: The date beside a day in Coming back.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: A save's own title when it sits under its reason, sheet titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Two waterfront sites are open Nov 14 to 16.
styles.usage: Summaries, the work a task comes back with, settings text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Sources, times, the capture line, field labels.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Uppercase: the app line on a moment, day names, the Issue masthead. Nothing longer than four words.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a reason and its source line.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between buttons in a row; inside a meta line.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Notification and Live Activity padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter; card padding in the app; between rows.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections of a screen.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above a screen's first heading.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Empty-state breathing room.

tokens.name: radius-picture
tokens.usage: Picture frames: page pictures, photos, thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, the microphone, the quiet strip.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, notifications, the Live Activity, sheets. The largest corner Shoebox draws; no pills, no circles except the progress dot.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards and the Issue cover lifted off surface or deep. Pair with shadow-edge.

tokens.name: shadow-edge
tokens.usage: The thin inner edge of a card, in the edge color.

tokens.name: tap
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything you tap.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Every outline and divider. Nothing heavier.

tokens.name: app-mark
tokens.usage: The app mark on a moment's top line.
